items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps sensitive, oily-looking skin comfortable while it adjusts.
Lightweight niacinamide gel helps keep shine in check and supports a smoother-looking finish without adding strong actives.
Mineral SPF 50 suits fair, sensitive-leaning skin and helps keep tone looking even.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel because it is very strong for sensitive skin that is new to exfoliating, and a gentle routine used daily is a better start for the look of texture. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, apply sunscreen each morning, and if you still want more polish after a few weeks, ask us about a milder exfoliating step.
